_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Durable transcription queue states render in exact order, also after a reload. The test seeded a conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} whose server data reports four queued messages, in this order: a plain message "echo: first queued message"; a transcription still working on /tmp/shelley-uploads/working.webm with the context "Keep this image [/tmp/shelley-uploads/context.png]"; a ready transcription of /tmp/shelley-uploads/ready.webm with the text "Finished spoken words."; and a failed transcription of /tmp/shelley-uploads/failed.webm with the error "transcription unavailable". The live event stream is cut off. Requests to send a queued message now (POST /api/conversation/<id>/send-queued?queued_id=<id>) are accepted without effect; call "sendQueued" reports the first one as "<method> /send-queued?<query>" ("none" before there is one). "The items" are the elements matching '[data-testid="queued-ghost"], [data-testid="transcription-task"]', in document order. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait up to 30s for the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) to be visible.
2. There should be exactly 4 items. Item 1 should contain "first queued message"; item 2 "Transcribing…", "working.webm" and "Keep this image"; item 3 "Finished spoken words." and "Queued"; item 4 "Recording failed" and "transcription unavailable".
3. There should be exactly 2 [data-testid="queued-ghost"], exactly 2 [data-testid="transcription-task"] and exactly 1 [data-testid="send-queued-now"].
4. Click [data-testid="send-queued-now"]. Call "sendQueued" should return "POST /send-queued?queued_id=q-first".
5. Reload: navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} again. The URL should have exactly the path "/c/{{SLUG}}" (an exact "value", not "text").
6. There should again be exactly 4 items: item 1 containing "first queued message", item 2 "working.webm", item 3 "Finished spoken words." and item 4 "failed.webm".
